gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the front-plus-rear kits are locked to their own rear camera and cable (VIOFO A229 Plus/Pro: USB-C, 6 m in the 2CH box, not extendable with USB cables; A329S: coaxial; the 4K RNE800 rear camera fits only the A229 Ultra), or what the matching hardwire kit costs at the maker's store today (HK6 $25.99, HK4 $17.99).
standout_why: Compared against thecargearguide's A229 Plus vs A229 Pro vs A329S page (cited) and productbible's front-and-rear page (in results). Both already state the main compatibility fact: the A329S needs the HK6 for hybrid parking, the A229 Pro/Plus use the HK4, microSD tops out at 512 GB, and only the A329S takes an SSD (up to 4 TB). Neither gives a kit price. Neither gives the rear cable length in the box: productbible says only 'check the length included before you buy', and thecargearguide says only 'lengths up to 20 m available' for the A329S. Neither says whether rear cameras or cables swap between models, and neither covers the Vantrue S1 Pro Max accessories. Car and Driver (cited) returned a fetch error and Vortex Radar (cited) returned 403, so I could not compare against them.
decides: It confirms the pick order and corrects the cost and upgrade path. With parking mode, the A329S 2CH is $485.98 ($459.99 + HK6 $25.99) and the A229 Pro 2CH is $367.98 ($349.99 + HK4 $17.99) at viofo.com on 2026-11-26. A buyer who wants a 4K rear camera cannot add one to an A229 Pro or Plus later, because VIOFO says the RNE800 fits only the A229 Ultra front unit; they must buy a 4K+4K kit from the start (A229 Ultra, or our Vantrue S1 Pro Max 4K+4K at $239.99). That supports the S1 Pro Max 4K+4K winning the 'rear detail' segment, not the overall pick. For long vehicles, VIOFO's A229 rear cable cannot be extended with a USB cable (longer 8 m and 10 m cables are listed), and Vantrue lists a 29.5 ft rear cable for the S1 Pro Max at $15.99.
